question: How should the jewel-mantras be applied in relation to the head?
premises: The action involves holding on the head.
The holding is done three times.
Rotation is performed with the jewel-mantras.
inference: After holding on the head three times, one should rotate with the jewel-mantras.
uncertainties: The exact identity of the ratna-vidyās is not specified.
plain_english: Having held it on the head three times, one should rotate it with the jewel-mantras.
